title: 3.7 My, Your, His, and Her
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to give a name and limited age/origin/job information and describe simple possession.
goal: Use my, your, his, and her before familiar names and objects with explicit ownership and speaker perspective.
grammar_function: Possessive adjective + noun: my/your/his/her name or object. My/your expand beyond the fixed 3.1 name chunks here.
prerequisite: 3.1 fixed my/your name chunks, 3.2 speaker perspective, 3.6 known people, and Unit 2 objects/demonstratives.
speaking_outcome: Repeat two name statements and four object-ownership statements using all four possessive adjectives.
